fields.name: originArRedBlueAmount

fields.desc: 跨合同转账，带合同号的应收单跟其他合同号（不带合同号、同一合同号不同行号、不同合同号）的应收单 收款红蓝核销的原币金额，同合同同标的红蓝核销不回写

fields.name: originArRedBlueAmountD

writeBackExpr.validateExpr: case when concat(arContract.controlFields) not like '%ContractMustInputFieldsEnum.amount%' then false when (coalesce(zeroRowExecutionDirectionId, '') = '' or coalesce(zeroRowExecutionDirectionId, '') = 'ZeroRowExecutionDirection.positiveNumber') and originAmount = 0 and originReceiptAmount < 0 then true when (coalesce(zeroRowExecutionDirectionId, '') = '' or coalesce(zeroRowExecutionDirectionId, '') = 'ZeroRowExecutionDirection.positiveNumber') and originAmount != 0 and originAmount * originReceiptAmount < 0 then true when coalesce(zeroRowExecutionDirectionId, '') = 'ZeroRowExecutionDirection.negativeNumber' and originAmount = 0 and originReceiptAmount > 0 then true when coalesce(zeroRowExecutionDirectionId, '') = 'ZeroRowExecutionDirection.negativeNumber' and originAmount = 0 and originAmount * originReceiptAmount < 0 then true else false end
writeBackExpr.expression: sum(case when verificationTypeId = 'VerificationType.redBlue' and coalesce(contractSubjectMatterItemId,'') != coalesce(partyItem.contractSubjectMatterItemId,'') and srcItemObjectType != 'ReceiptItem' and partyItem.srcItemObjectType != 'ReceiptItem' then originDebitDeclaredAmount + originCreditDeclaredAmount else 0 end)
